idea: Themed weeks, week four, Markets day: written from the source, then corrected by a numbers editor and a viewer editor before voicing.
description: NSE-registered investors recorded in Assam rose from 2.2 lakh on 31 March 2020 to 29.4 lakh on 31 August 2026, 13.3 times as many. India's count rose 4.4 times. Assam's share of India's registered investors went from 0.7% to 2.2%.

Most of the rise came by March 2025, 11.4 times the March 2020 count; since then Assam's count rose 16% and India's 20%. A registered investor is a PAN registered with NSE whether or not it has traded, placed in a state by PIN code. It is a small base: Assam has 2.6% of India's projected population. Every state's count rose; 12 smaller states and UTs that NSE groups as Others are blank on the map. 1 lakh = 100 thousand.
source: National Stock Exchange of India, NSE Market Pulse: unique registered investors, distinct PANs registered with NSE whether or not they have traded, placed in a state by PIN code. September 2026 Table 70 for 31 March 2020, 31 March 2025 and 31 August 2026; April 2026 Table 43 for 31 March 2026. 1 lakh = 100 thousand. Population share: National Commission on Population projections (July 2020 edition), 1 March 2020 and 1 July 2026.
source_short: NSE, Market Pulse, Mar 2020 to 31 Aug 2026
